QUIC service timer queue types and timer management functions.

# Purpose
This header defines the service timer queue interface for QUIC connections. It declares the data structures used to track connection timers, including an instant queue, a dynamic priority queue, and per-connection metadata stored in `fd_quic_svc_timers_conn_meta_t`. It also declares setup and runtime functions to allocate, initialize, schedule, cancel, query, validate, and count timer events for `fd_quic_conn_t` objects. The file contains only type definitions, constants, and function prototypes, so it serves as the public API for the QUIC service queue logic.
